concerns.title: Validity reconstructed from mutable sentinel state
concerns.mechanism: Several mutable flags written across parsing paths are combined again by result(); some writes cannot survive the version_changed terminal result.
concerns.maintenance_task_cost: Understanding which validity result and issue location survive a session/build transition requires tracking flag lifetimes across consume_line, room handling, match finish and result.
concerns.qualifying_alternative_candidate: Explicit per-match exclusion facts and a focused file classification step; preserve all existing outcomes except separately authorized provenance bug fixes.
concerns.disposition_note: PR74 merged 30ee8b132adf245fd060d417cb48b23b9ad09e81; sentinel flags removed. Sticky-continuity runtime bug is a separate concern.

concerns.title: Positional parse result and redundant match intermediate
concerns.mechanism: Per-file three-part positional tuple is repeated four times, and _FoundMatch converts one-to-one to _ParsedMatch while file_ref is already available at construction.
concerns.maintenance_task_cost: Adding or inspecting per-file evidence requires coordinating repeated tuple signatures/position-based unpacking and tracing a representation conversion with no separate policy.
concerns.qualifying_alternative_candidate: Name the per-file fact/result contract and construct the final private match representation at the existing ownership point when this does not scatter parsing knowledge.
concerns.disposition_note: PR74 replaces the tuple with _FileResult and removes _FoundMatch. Do not score absence of a dataclass/helper itself.

concerns.title: Public unqualified line duplicates occurrence locations
concerns.mechanism: After overlap merging, ArchiveScenario.line is retained from one occurrence without its file identity, while locations carries authoritative (file_ref,line) pairs.
concerns.maintenance_task_cost: Implementing an archive-location consumer must determine which of two public location representations is meaningful after merging, or add undocumented coupling to occurrence order.
concerns.qualifying_alternative_candidate: Expose authoritative locations only, or make the occurrence relationship explicit; preserve all locations and source privacy.
concerns.disposition_note: Removed by bd9d9a4; verification review 5331457940. Score maintenance ambiguity separately from an invented current wrong-file runtime defect.

concerns.title: Premature replay_ready public state
concerns.mechanism: An always-false field is exported by public models and CLI although production_support already distinguishes supported decision classes; trace extraction owns later readiness semantics.
concerns.maintenance_task_cost: Implementing the #66 extraction contract must reconcile an already published boolean with readiness that the inspector does not compute; current consumers must distinguish two overlapping support/readiness concepts.
concerns.qualifying_alternative_candidate: Defer readiness state to the extraction owner, or establish a separately required inspector meaning.
concerns.disposition_note: Removed by bd9d9a4. Historically accepted removal is not proof of a present task cost; exclude from gold if independent neutral adjudication finds only speculative API preference.

concerns.title: Freshness policy reconstructed in separate modules
concerns.mechanism: meta_context adds window_end and max_age while metagame checks day differences and qualification repeats the policy.
concerns.maintenance_task_cost: Changing the freshness boundary requires coordinated edits across context expiry, source selection and qualification; otherwise pin eligibility and availability drift.
concerns.qualifying_alternative_candidate: One policy-owned freshness boundary consumed by all existing paths; moving only one expression leaves duplication.
concerns.disposition_note: d0c3579 adds FreshnessPolicy.fresh_through/is_fresh and uses them across source qualification, selection and context expiry; reviewer 5402599766 independently accepted fix.

concerns.title: Repeated availability and redundant prevalence branch
concerns.mechanism: _unavailable_reason already obtains availability; _derive obtains it again and gates fresh_manifests by a condition implied after catalog/legality checks.
concerns.maintenance_task_cost: Establishing what the conditional can change requires tracing three functions across two modules; changing availability/disclosure logic repeats that reasoning.
concerns.qualifying_alternative_candidate: Validate mismatch inputs first, compute availability once, and use fresh source selection directly while preserving prevalence disclosure.
concerns.disposition_note: d0c3579 removes duplicate availability lookup and conditional; accepted as advisory, never a current correctness failure.

concerns.title: Match eligibility split across optional-context and spine boundaries
concerns.mechanism: spine revalidates artifacts and checks catalog identity with silent None, while meta_context_for_match checks profile, legality and temporal eligibility with domain reasons.
concerns.maintenance_task_cost: Explaining all eligibility outcomes or extending an eligibility rule requires tracing two owners plus retained-pin validation; domain boundary cannot describe damaged-artifact/catalog decisions.
concerns.qualifying_alternative_candidate: Unify eligibility classification at meta_context_for_match; spine gates optional input and delegates; retain defensive PinnedMatch consistency.
concerns.disposition_note: Issue95 remains open; issue comment reports local implementation 1e8ab5eab9496da88fe20d3945c16d760a3f0b1e and tests, with no merged PR. Current main still splits ownership.

concerns.title: Projection-to-boolean-to-disclosure plumbing
concerns.mechanism: Three builders convert projection to bool, defaulted helpers turn bool back into uncertainty; omission is accepted by the helper signature then rejected at request validation.
concerns.maintenance_task_cost: Adding a builder must coordinate projection, optional default flag and disclosure invariant; the signature conceals required projection knowledge.
concerns.qualifying_alternative_candidate: Require the actual projection and derive disclosure once; keep request consistency validation.
concerns.disposition_note: 03bf05af fixes all three builders and both helper signatures; reply 4175200696 verifies tests. Do not claim existing builder output is incorrect.

concerns.title: Campaign admission precedence and refusal mapping duplicated
concerns.mechanism: _campaign_stop repeats record_attempt refusal order, while _MeasuredGenerator repeats refusal-to-shortfall conversion.
concerns.maintenance_task_cost: Adding a refusal reason or changing precedence requires editing three places in step; same state can yield different shortfall if copies drift.
concerns.qualifying_alternative_candidate: One campaign-owned admissibility policy and one refusal-to-shortfall mapping; retain durable admission and pre-case stop before construction/input capture.
concerns.disposition_note: Open #104; no structural fix in 7fce676. The billed/campaign hybrid runtime bug is separate.

concerns.title: Candidate price and absent-price resolution repeated
concerns.mechanism: Five helpers repeat price lookup and absent-input guards; subscription support changes all their accepted inputs.
concerns.maintenance_task_cost: Changing price/currency/absent accounting semantics requires coordinating helpers while preserving absent input versus unpriced configuration versus legitimate zero cost.
concerns.qualifying_alternative_candidate: Resolve price and required funding/input context once per candidate; preserve None/zero distinctions instead of passing price alone.
concerns.disposition_note: Annotation fixed by 7fce676; broader policy ownership remains open. Annotation correction alone does not confirm the structural alternative is safe.

concerns.title: Untyped operational freeze failures at public boundary
concerns.mechanism: Routine stale/tampered/malformed operational failures expose bare ValueError text, including Pydantic ValidationError.
concerns.maintenance_task_cost: Callers selecting recovery must parse text and distinguish several exception sources; next error additions require coordinating an undocumented string protocol.
concerns.qualifying_alternative_candidate: Typed boundary error with a reason, or typed failure values, leaving invariant/misuse guards intact.
concerns.disposition_note: f5145112 adds ProfileFreezeError/reasons, final rebased bd423531 retains it. Review classifies this as blocking contract/correctness. Keep outside primary structural recall to avoid mixing categories.

concerns.title: Freeze/load validity policy duplicated and order coupled
concerns.mechanism: freeze_profiles and LoadedProfileFreeze repeat cases/ranking/status/packet/implementation checks in different order; loading verifies review twice to avoid a KeyError.
concerns.maintenance_task_cost: Adding a freeze precondition requires editing both paths and preserving review-before-packet order; otherwise accepted selections/manifests can diverge.
concerns.qualifying_alternative_candidate: One private freeze-validity owner returning exact profiles; load adds manifest-specific checks and verifies review once in safe order.
concerns.disposition_note: Explicit acceptance reply 4190269653; #109 open and current main retains duplicate policy. No implemented evidence of full alternative yet.

concerns.title: Internal lock-state checks borrow a fake reviewer identity
concerns.mechanism: Four internal flows call public locked_reviews with next(iter(_packets)) only to bypass caller authorization; adjudicator packet calls for exception then recurses through packet.
concerns.maintenance_task_cost: Changing caller-specific behavior forces maintainers to account for internal flows whose placeholder is not a real caller; proving lock order requires traversing authorization and packet recursion.
concerns.qualifying_alternative_candidate: Private owner of two-locked-reviews invariant; public guard authorizes then delegates; preserve error and packet order.
concerns.disposition_note: Explicit acceptance reply 4190269861; #110 open, placeholder calls remain on current main. Do not replace it with a named property that preserves coupling.
